subject: Coord: Global dedicated demo — reviewer availability & DST collision
messages:
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: elaine@vectrahealth.com, tom.reed@bellevista.io
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-03T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated/private demo — initial slot options and reviewer asks

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks again for the interest in a dedicated/private walkthrough. We want to make sure both your EU DPO and APAC security reviewer can attend. Quick context: there is a DST transition next week in the EU which tightens the overlap window for EU/US/APAC. To avoid multiple reschedules I wanted to propose a plan and capture any hard constraints up front.

Option A (single live session):
 - Tue Apr 6 — 15:00 UTC (08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 JST+1) — requires EU DPO and APAC lead to join; risk: late for APAC.
Option B (split two short sessions):
 - EU/US session: Tue Apr 6 — 15:00 UTC (live demo + security Q&A with EU DPO)
 - APAC live Q&A: Wed Apr 7 — 23:00 UTC (recorded demo + live Q&A with APAC sec lead)

Please tell us: (1) which option you prefer, (2) any absolute no-go windows for your reviewers, and (3) whether we should share SOC 2 and the data-flow diagram ahead of the call (we can attach).

Attached: draft agenda (redwood-dedicated-demo-agenda.pdf). I’ll hold tentative invites until we confirm.

Thanks —
Diego\Senior Solutions Engineer\Redwood Inference

From: elaine@vectrahealth.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reed@bellevista.io
Date: 2027-04-03T11:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private demo — initial slot options and reviewer asks

Diego —

Appreciate the options. Quick constraints from our side:
 - EU DPO is out Mon/Tue morning CEST; available Tue after 14:30 CEST and Wed all day.
 - APAC sec lead (Kai) is traveling and prefers local evenings; they flagged late UTC slots only (21:00–02:00 UTC) as realistic.
 - Procurement would like the technical artifacts (SOC2 summary, data-flow) before the EU session if possible.

Split sessions sound workable; if you can run the full demo for EU/US and then a recorded+Q&A for APAC that matches our reviewers' windows, that would be our preference. Let's try Option B.

Elaine Park\Director of IT & Security\Vectra Health

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: elaine@vectrahealth.com
Date: 2027-04-03T13:10:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private demo — initial slot options and reviewer asks

All —

If Vectra prefers Option B, operationally we recommend:
 - EU/US live (60 mins): architecture -> deployment topology -> live private demo -> EU-specific data handling + SOC2 Q&A. EU DPO attendance required.
 - APAC Q&A (30 mins): recorded demo (20m) + focused Q&A with APAC sec lead (Kai). We can run the recorded demo from the same environment; Neha will own the APAC Q&A.

Proposed times (converted):
 - EU/US live: Tue Apr 6 15:00 UTC / 17:00 CEST / 08:00 PDT
 - APAC Q&A: Wed Apr 7 23:00 UTC / Thu Apr 8 08:00 JST / 16:00 PDT (recorded)

I’ll prepare a short reviewer pack and attach SOC2-summary.pdf and the data-flow-diagram.pdf to the EU invite if Diego confirms. Also noting: we may need SSO test accounts for the EU DPO to validate SAML metadata — can Vectra provision two test accounts?

Karthik\Solutions Architect\Redwood Inference

From: kai.tanaka@medapac.jp (APAC Security Lead)
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, elaine@vectrahealth.com
Date: 2027-04-03T21:05:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private demo — initial slot options and reviewer asks

Hi Diego / Elaine —

I can join live for Q&A only in the 21:00–02:00 UTC window this week; I won’t be able to attend a daytime UTC session. I’m fine with a recorded demo + live Q&A at 23:00 UTC on Wed Apr 7. Please ensure logs/retention and key management (KMS) notes are in the prep pack.

Regards,
Kai Tanaka\APAC Security Lead\MedAPAC (external reviewer)

From: dpo@payer.eu (EU DPO)
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private demo — initial slot options and reviewer asks

Diego/Karthik —

I can attend Tue Apr 6 after 14:30 CEST or Wed Apr 7 09:00–12:00 CEST. Confirm the EU/US session no earlier than 15:00 UTC and share the SOC2 summary in advance. I will review the SAML metadata if you provide a test SP.

— EU DPO

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: elaine@vectrahealth.com, dpo@payer.eu, kai.tanaka@medapac.jp
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, tom.reed@bellevista.io
Date: 2027-04-04T15:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private demo — initial slot options and reviewer asks

Thanks everyone — glad we have overlapping windows. Final proposal based on availability:

1) EU / US live session (mandatory for EU DPO):
   - Tue Apr 6, 15:00 UTC (17:00 CEST / 08:00 PDT) — 60 minutes\   - Deliverables before session: SOC2-summary.pdf, data-flow-diagram.pdf, SAML test metadata (we will send test SP SAML by EOD Mon Apr 5)
   - Invite: demo-invite-eu.ics (attached)

2) APAC recorded demo + live Q&A (for Kai):
   - Wed Apr 7, 23:00 UTC (Thu Apr 8 08:00 JST) — 30 minutes (recording available)\   - Focus: KMS, retention windows, cross-border controls; we will include logs retention examples in the prep pack
   - Invite: demo-invite-apac.ics (attached)

If this matches, I’ll send the two calendar invites and a reviewer pack (SOC2-summary.pdf, data-flow-diagram.pdf). Tom / Elaine — please confirm who on your side will join each session so we can set attendee permissions.

Diego\Senior Solutions Engineer\Redwood Inference

From: elaine@vectrahealth.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reed@bellevista.io, dpo@payer.eu, kai.tanaka@medapac.jp
Date: 2027-04-05T17:42:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private demo — final confirmation

Diego —

This works. Confirmation:
 - EU/US live (Tue Apr 6 15:00 UTC): Elaine Park (IT & Security), Tom Reed (Engineering), EU DPO (dpo@payer.eu)\ - APAC Q&A (Wed Apr 7 23:00 UTC): Kai Tanaka (APAC sec lead), plus one engineer (michael.ito@vectrahealth.com) — Michael will join the Q&A only.

Please send the invites and the reviewer pack. Procurement would also like to confirm licensing & a draft MSA before the EU session if possible — I’ll loop in procurement in a separate email.

Thanks,
Elaine
